column1: # Chat spellings of common Nepali words that the tables don't reach: latin<TAB>nepali.
# Hand-written for this repository from how people write Nepali in Latin letters, not taken
# from any dataset; see data/manifests/chat-forms-ne.json. The Nepali pack's "chatForms" file,
# read by the engine (engine/core/src/chat_forms.rs). A typed word matching a row (ignoring
# case) offers its Nepali word as if the letters spelled it out; a swipe through a row's
# letters offers it too.
# A word of one consonant walks without its vowel (र is r, छ is chh), and its key is that one
# letter; typed with the vowel (ra, chha), the key keeps the a, because the skeleton drops a
# final vowel only from three letters up. So the commonest such words, which are among the
# most written of all, are listed as they are typed. म (I) still comes after मा (in), which
# the text has fourteen times as often.
ra
ma
na
ta
cha
chha
# छ is typed x in chat (xa, garxu, hunxa); the skeleton folds x to c, which reaches the longer
# words, but xa is two letters, so it is listed too.
xa
